name: Zone 2 ride
notes: A steady ride under the zone 2 ceiling in Settings. After a talk test, set the ceiling from its summary first. The day after a leg session, easy cycling helps recovery. On a lifting day, ride after the lifting.

steps.title: Zone 2
steps.cue: Stay under the ceiling. Adjust resistance only; keep cadence steady.

steps.title: Cool-down
steps.cue: Spin easily, then stop any watch recording.
